title: CuerPOWER
tagline: 24/7 intelligent AI coach for fitness, nutrition, and personalized habit accountability.
summary: We engineered an intelligent, conversational AI coach integrated with wearable data to deliver real-time personalized guidance on nutrition, fitness regimens, and daily accountability.
challenge: Generic fitness apps suffered from high churn and lacked true conversational personalization. Users needed adaptive daily encouragement and immediate answers to nutrition questions based on dynamic workout history and biometric feedback.
solution: Built a custom multi-agent LLM pipeline combining retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with user biometric tracking, instant meal logging via computer vision, and adaptive weekly routine calibrations.
overview: CuerPOWER is a next-generation health companion engineered to bridge the gap between static workout trackers and human personal trainers. By synthesizing continuous health metrics from wearables with proprietary nutrition intelligence models, the platform delivers context-aware, empathetic, and actionable coaching in real-time.
deliverables: Multi-agent conversational LLM coaching pipeline
Cross-platform iOS & Android application in React Native
Sub-350ms RAG knowledge retrieval backend in FastAPI
Automated biometric data aggregation & caloric sync microservice
Real-time streak retention & intelligent push notification engine
architecture: Hybrid RAG architecture combining Milvus vector embeddings with structured relational telemetry
Asynchronous message streaming over WebSockets for zero-perceived-latency AI responses
End-to-end HIPAA-compliant encrypted user data pipelines hosted on AWS ECS

testimonial.quote: Business Evolution AI transformed our vision into an intuitive, lightning-fast product that our users genuinely engage with multiple times every single day.
testimonial.author: Marcus Vance

title: PrimeAgeFit
tagline: Hyper-personalized adaptive fitness and nutrition plans tailored for individuals over 40.
summary: Developed a full-stack digital product and intelligent algorithmic engine that adapts exercise loads, joint-friendly workouts, and metabolic nutrition tracking for longevity-focused fitness.
challenge: Most fitness platforms focus on high-impact workouts unsuitable for mature adults. The client required an intuitive interface with strict biomechanical safety rules, progressive overload prevention, and custom AI progression curves.
solution: Architected a React and Node.js platform with specialized ML models trained on longevity exercise science, automatic form coaching, and GoHighLevel client retention automation.
overview: PrimeAgeFit addresses the specific physiological demands of fitness enthusiasts over 40. The platform replaces generic high-impact workout libraries with a dynamic routine generator that factors in joint history, recovery scores, and metabolic targets to optimize longevity without injury.
deliverables: Custom algorithmic workout planner tailored to joint load tolerances
High-converting Next.js responsive web application & member dashboard
Automated client onboarding and retention workflows via GoHighLevel
Video stream library with low-latency CDN delivery
Tiered membership subscription billing via Stripe
architecture: Serverless architecture with Next.js App Router and PostgreSQL on Supabase
Automated event webhooks triggering personalized SMS and email accountability flows
Edge-cached content delivery ensuring instant page loads globally

testimonial.quote: Our membership conversion skyrocketed after launching the new platform. The attention to detail and user flow is second to none.
testimonial.author: Elena Rostova

title: Praxis Media
tagline: Interactive AI reading experience providing instant semantic search and deep insights.
summary: Transformed long-form literature and educational content into interactive, querying knowledge bases where readers can converse with documents, extract concepts, and explore citations in real-time.
challenge: Navigating complex research and lengthy books caused reader fatigue. Static PDF and e-book formats offered no contextual understanding, cross-referencing capabilities, or interactive synthesis.
solution: Engineered a vector embedding retrieval architecture using Milvus, LangChain, and a responsive reading UI with instant chapter summaries, entity graphs, and personalized AI comprehension tutors.
overview: Praxis Media redefines how knowledge workers interact with deep literature. By indexing entire book corpora and technical papers into vector spaces, users can pose natural language queries, generate comparative synthesis across chapters, and receive sourced citations instantly.
deliverables: Interactive reader interface with synchronized contextual AI assistant
High-throughput vector indexing pipeline for multi-format publications
Semantic search engine with millisecond keyword & concept matching
Automated AI synthesis, study guides, and executive chapter briefs
User highlight sync and cloud-based knowledge graph visualizer
architecture: LangChain and Milvus vector clustering with semantic chunking algorithms
FastAPI microservice handling document chunking, embeddings, and token streaming
Next.js frontend with optimistic UI updates and dark/light reading modes

testimonial.quote: The platform has transformed how our readers digest dense literature. It turns passive reading into an active dialogue.
testimonial.author: Julian Thorne

title: Strategic Divorce Directory

Client inquiry screening system with fraud protection and rate limiting
SEO-optimized directory pages generating organic search traffic

title: Foreclosurebid AI
tagline: AI-driven real estate rankings, risk analysis, and automated market insights nationwide.
summary: Created an algorithmic property scoring platform that aggregates county auction datasets, predicts auction margins, and generates automated risk scores for institutional real estate investors.
challenge: Real estate auction data is fragmented across thousands of county portals with missing metadata, unrecorded liens, and volatile pricing histories, making manual valuation painfully slow and risky.
solution: Developed automated ETL web scrapers, computer vision for property image inspection, and gradient-boosted pricing models to evaluate over 500,000 active foreclosures daily.
overview: Foreclosurebid AI empowers distressed asset funds and real estate investors with predictive intelligence. By unifying county recorder datasets, tax liens, neighborhood velocity, and satellite imagery, the platform surfaces high-alpha auction opportunities in minutes.
deliverables: Distributed ETL scraper pipelines pulling county auction feeds across 48 states
Proprietary predictive valuation & repair cost estimation ML model
Interactive map dashboard with spatial filtering and risk HeatMaps
Institutional portfolio export tools and automated deal alert webhooks
Enterprise multi-seat tenant management and permissioning
architecture: Python microservices orchestrated with Celery and Redis message queues
PostgreSQL data warehouse with spatial geometry indexing
Modern React and Tailwind frontend with WebGL map rendering

testimonial.quote: Foreclosurebid AI reduced our deal evaluation timeframe from days to seconds. The data accuracy is unmatched in the industry.
testimonial.author: Harrison Reid
